pairs.subject: russian
pairs.evidence: src/i18n/useTranslation.ts:506 The runtime's only count tool is plain `{var}` substitution: it never selects a plural form, nothing in src/ uses Intl.PluralRules, and call sites pick between two `_one`/`_other` keys, so Russian's one/few/many categories cannot render, and 122 `_other` strings in ru.json are frozen genitive plurals («{count} файлов») that come out wrong at 2-4, 22-24 and so on.

techniques.evidence: src/i18n/locales/ru.json:1194 Two-slot runtime with no few/many slots. About 128 `_other` strings correctly use the colon form («Агентов: {count}»), but 122 freeze the 5+ form, and a few use the «агент(ов)» hack (line 2417). This is the RU-FROZEN failure, and the runtime gap is a source-side defect that should be filed once.

src/i18n/locales/ru.json:348 Straight ASCII quotes around a search term instead of «». The catalog also has 24 spaced hyphens used as the copular dash (e.g. line 19572 «Политика выполнения - это») and 14 three-dot ellipses («Отправка...»). Guillemets (407) and … (841) dominate, but the sweep is incomplete.

src/i18n/locales/ru.json:378 The placeholder sits in an accusative object slot with no insulating head noun (also «Удалить {name}» at line 2306). Other strings do insulate correctly («Удалить метку «{name}»?» at line 14682), so the catalog is inconsistent.

src/i18n/locales/ru.json:8433 A masculine past-tense verb agrees with an arbitrary `{project}` name (RU-GENDER exposure; same at 8434 «{project} израсходовал»). Aspect itself looks right: «Удалить» on controls, «Загрузка…»/«Сохранение…» for progress.

src/i18n/locales/ru.json:5319 Formal вы imperatives throughout (about 1,524 `-ите` hits) and zero mid-sentence politeness capitals (Вы/Ваш/Вам/Вас). The ты-forms found (e.g. line 16739 «Что ты умеешь?») are prompts the user sends to the AI companion, not product-to-user address.

pairs.registryProposal: plural-and-count-agreement could cover the case of an unshipped but committed catalog: whether latent defects in a locale the build does not ship (behind a SHIPPED list) should count as deviations or be held until the locale is revived.
